newsitem.title: UK: Yavlinsky sees negative '97 GDP growth for Russia.
newsitem.headline: Yavlinsky sees negative '97 GDP growth for Russia.

text.p: Russia's best growth scenario for 1997 is minus 2.0 to 2.5 percent GDP growth, Grigory Yavlinsky, member of the State Duma (Parliament) and head of Russia's opposition liberal Yabloko party told an investment conference on eastern and central Europe on Saturday.
"It will be a difficult year for economic growth. The best scenario forecast for the year is minus 2.0 to 2.5 percent," Yavlinsky, who was a candidate in Russia's 1996 presidential election, said.
Added to this, he said 82 percent of Russia's financial resources were concentrated in Moscow.
"This is my pain," he said. "It is a kind of feudalism."
Yavlinsky said he had great faith in the Russia's next generation.

"Now we basically have the same people as before ...the next generation will be great and I have no doubt that in 20 years time, we will be out of this mess." -- Hayley Pienaar, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7718
